Proposition
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0055 1. Proposition 2.20\group neckpinch

For a rotationally symmetric solution with $|\psi _s|\le 1$ and $R>0$ initially, the slope bound persists, the curvature is controlled by $\psi ^{-2}$, the minimum of $K_1$ is nondecreasing, the scalar curvature stays positive, $\psi _t<0$, $\psi ^2$ is uniformly Lipschitz in time, and $\psi (x,T)$ exists pointwise if the solution exists up to time $T$.
